title: Certified Computational Reuse Under Environmental Change

claims.statement: Every computational system's lifecycle resource expenditure is measured as a 5-dimensional vector (steps, time_s, joules, memory_bytes, communication_bytes) partitioned exhaustively across execution, trace_recording, learning, guarding, and reconfiguration, with physical energy, modeled proxy energy, human time, and monetary projections maintained in strictly separate unit ledgers.
assumptions: All system operations are instrumented under a shared accounting boundary.
Modeled energy is explicitly tagged `modeled_proxy` whenever hardware counters are absent.
Unlike physical and human units are never summed without an explicit conversion model.
counterexamples: Exp 1 synchronous JSONL trace serialization flips modeled energy negative (-7.1%) while cutting ops (+12.7%), proving steps and energy must stay separate.
limitations: Proxy energy model does not substitute for hardware RAPL/SMC or external power metering.

claims.statement: For a deterministic topologically ordered computational DAG G and an exclusive globally Lipschitz-continuous sub-DAG cone I feeding a saturating or discrete target node v in {THRESHOLD, RELU, CLAMP}, if boundary drift satisfies sum_{b in B} L_b * |u_b - u0_b| + eps_fp < margin(p(u0)), then skipping evaluation of all nodes in I U {v} produces an output observationally identical to full DAG evaluation (RESTRICTED_WORST_CASE guarantee, zero false-SAFE errors).
assumptions: Target DAG is deterministic and topologically ordered with immutable internal cone structure.
Every internal node in cone I belongs to LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_OPS with exact partial bounds.
Exclusive ownership holds: no node outside I U {v} reads any node in I.
IEEE-754 safety margin eps_fp strictly dominates floating-point rounding error.
counterexamples: High-entropy shock regime (Exp 1+2): soundness holds (0 errors) but hit rate collapses, causing -47.7% op overhead without adaptive retirement.
Periodically sampled canaries (Exp 2, P=5..50): lack formal soundness and suffer 77.6%-98.4% output mismatch rates.
limitations: Applies only to continuous Lipschitz cones feeding flat/saturated target gates, not arbitrary discontinuous DAGs.
Energy savings are currently modeled via CPU-time/memory proxy rather than hardware power metering.

claims.statement: The union of K certified global-Lipschitz validity balls (Multi-Anchor Validity Atlas, P6) preserves exact observational equivalence on every input falling inside any ball, and achieves positive net operation savings over conventional incremental computation iff empirical hit rate h exceeds h_min = (c_guard + c_reanchor) / (k_eff + c_reanchor) (Theorem 2).
assumptions: Global Lipschitz vector L holds across all cached anchors (inherited from TS-001).
Stationary trigger statistics for exact Theorem 2 break-even bound; online drift regret (P5) remains open.
counterexamples: Exp 2 shock-rate sweep: static contracts flip net-negative above shock probability p ~ 0.11 (-30.05% at p=0.60).
Exp 1 full_materialized traces: -167% ops vs incremental (never pays back).
Milestone recurring_states: combinatorial boundary mixing yields -3.34% ops even with Multi-Anchor Atlas.
limitations: Non-stationary adaptive-retirement regret bound (P5) is only partially proved.
Synchronous disk JSONL tracing offsets modeled energy savings (-2.3% to -7.1%) despite +14-15% op savings.

claims.statement: For contractive dynamics R_{t+1} = phi * R_t + w_t with |phi| < 1, bounded disturbance |w_t| <= W_max, and bounded measurement noise |eta_t| <= eta_max, an adaptive observer triggering observation whenever E_cert(t, tau) > eps(tau) guarantees 0% lookahead bound violations when feasible, and detects broken W_max assumptions via CanaryState.UNKNOWN escalation.
assumptions: Known contraction coefficient |phi| < 1 and bounded disturbance |w_t| <= W_max.
counterexamples: Exp 8 stationary linear-Gaussian regime: tuned periodic_kalman_p3 (33.4% obs, 1.15 J, 3.72% viol) outperforms adaptive_kalman_uncertainty (78.1% obs, 2.53 J, 1.42% viol).
Exp 8 unbounded Gaussian noise: P4 certified observer degrades to 100% continuous observation.
Exp 8 super-critical 2.4x shift: even continuous observation suffers 20.29% violations (irreducible P9 predictability floor).
Exp 3 adaptive observer: 203 safety violations & 0.2700 post-MSE vs 59 violations & 0.0222 MSE for observe-all.
limitations: Information-theoretic observation lower bound (P9) remains open.
Physical sensor energy is modeled rather than hardware-metered.

claims.statement: Combining mature sufficient Bayesian memory with a residual-surprise precision-retirement canary reduces routine timespace movement (Hellinger metric D_H = 0.043, 4.2x quieter than sliding-window baselines) while achieving rapid adaptation (19 steps, 6.08x Jump-to-Jitter ratio) and 98.85% action accuracy across structural regime shifts.
assumptions: Piece-wise stationary linear-Gaussian observation model with abrupt regime shifts.
Known relevant feature subset for mature sufficient memory.
counterexamples: Naive infinite memory (overconfident inertia): fails to adapt after shifts (65.94% action accuracy, Adapt=None).
Bloated irrelevant memory (bytes != sufficiency): 208x raw memory bytes explodes maintenance ops 196x while worsening MSE.
limitations: Empirical simulation result; formal competitive regret bounds under continuous drift remain open.

claims.statement: Previously executed computation can be safely reused within explicitly verified validity regions (Lipschitz cones, Multi-Anchor Validity Atlases, and bounded-disturbance P4 sync bounds), reducing cumulative operations relative to full recomputation and strong conventional incremental baselines within characterized volatility regimes.
assumptions: Inherits all assumptions of TS-BASE-001, TS-001, TS-002, TS-003, and TS-004.
Energy savings claims remain scoped to operation counts and modeled_proxy energy until hardware metering is executed.
counterexamples: High-entropy shocks, recurring combinatorial boundaries, synchronous disk JSONL I/O, stationary Gaussian Kalman optimality of periodic sensing, and overconfident memory.
limitations: Marked partially_supported pending physical hardware energy metering (RAPL/powermetrics) and P5/P9 proofs.
Does not claim P = NP, universal energy savings, or sound canaries for arbitrary environments.
